index_title: Terminal same-sort profile reproduction, no-return and complete-cylinder tests
scope: Private B051: FIVE remaining source09 results and FOUR equations, seven definitions, 32 human claims and five tasks. Original SAP alone proves equivalence reproduction and complete external-cylinder return; no-return needs only the relevant index-two exclusion and profile powers need full original NR2, not CCO. Terminal represented cover-layer reachability separately uses earlier RAW word representability and the positive FULL cover layer provider. No hidden/quotient SAP or arbitrary incomplete-cylinder return is inferred.
scope_explanation: statement and proof. J denotes the full original equivalence, J^circ its nonempty diversity palette. Quotient diagonal is lifted to J^circ only for J>Id. Original same-sort products commute; mixed word interiors keep actual typed order. Terminal/source representation gates and complete cylinder hypotheses remain separate.

assumptions.name: Actual homogeneous finite typed original source
assumptions.statement: M is homogeneous complete in a finite binary relational language with finitely many nonempty transitive named original sorts, symmetric actual same-sort diversity atoms and paired typed converses. All invariant same-sort relations are unions of finitely many old full-Aut pair orbitals. Logical Id is separate from diversity; words have actual old typed edges.

assumptions.name: Visible original SAP
assumptions.statement: The original finite age has SAP. Every nonzero invariant equivalence J>Id has infinite classes; finite diversity homomorphisms/word walks admit injective replacements with an already distinct endpoint pair pinned. No quotient/hidden SAP is assumed.

assumptions.name: Local no-index-two-above-J premise
assumptions.statement: For the no-return theorem at a fixed nonzero J, there is NO original invariant equivalence H>J with [H:J]=2. The standing terminal FULL NR2 hypothesis implies this, but the local no-return argument needs only this cut-specific exclusion. J may be Top, when the condition is vacuous.

assumptions.name: FULL original NR2 for profile powers and terminal wrappers
assumptions.statement: On the chosen original named sort, the FULL invariant-equivalence lattice has no relative-index-two interval. This is not merely a condition on represented exact equivalences. Finite old orbitals and actual SAP are retained; semantic CCO is unnecessary for the profile-power argument.

assumptions.name: Complete external quotient cylinders
assumptions.statement: For the return test J>Id and T,S are NONEMPTY full old diversity pullbacks of INDIVIDUAL complete Aut(M)-orbitals on (M_a/J)^2, both disjoint from J. They are J-bisaturated and symmetric. Completeness excludes arbitrary unions; neither CCO, NR2, MI nor exactness is assumed.

assumptions.name: Terminal represented cover-layer instance
assumptions.statement: For the represented wrapper, the actual source also has semantic HOM CCO, and J is a nonzero represented proper FULL exact MI with represented exact cover K. Full original NR2 in A04 identifies the full invariant and represented lattices via I05. The source09 positive external-layer theorem I06 is used only after this identification and positivity of J^circ are discharged.

imports.name: lem:typed-raw-strong-saturation
imports.statement: For nonzero original exterior kernels, diversity of full RAW saturation equals the STRONG exterior palette product; identity exteriors are omitted. Use the atom-union extension and RAW reflexivity to put an arbitrary old P INSIDE J^circ*P*J^circ. This inclusion does not follow from equivalence reproduction unless P is already inside J.
imports.provider_support_usage: Use the strict proved ancestor transition_closure C01 for purely relational binary word injectivisation with the endpoint fine pair type preserved and then aligned. It adds no theorem export and no exact-domain/Set-Pasch premise; it is used for general old profile walk readout.

imports.name: lem:typed-symmetric-orbital-commutation
imports.statement: Actual invariant RAW same-sort relations commute by endpoint swap. No mixed-sort relation reordering is asserted.

imports.name: lem:typed-quotient-strong-semigroup
imports.statement: At actual J>Id, Phi is injective, preserves meets/unions, sends Delta to NONEMPTY J^circ and preserves actual quotient products by choosing distinct old representatives. No quotient SAP/CCO is assumed.

imports.name: lem:typed-terminal-pure-power
imports.statement: Under original FULL NR2 and old SAP each atomic same-sort t has eventually constant positive STRONG powers equal to its connectedness palette. The support is selected only at C19/C21; no CCO or arbitrary quotient version is imported.

imports.name: lem:typed-all-invariant-equivalences-raw-word
imports.statement: FULL original NR2 gives one actual equality-inclusive RAW atomic word for every invariant equivalence, without CCO. Use only for identifying the represented MI/cover with FULL invariance and obtaining positive diversity words via old SAP.

imports.name: thm:typed-original-full-cover-layer-word
imports.statement: At a local FULL original cover Id<J<K with J^circ one positive old word, the external layer K minus J has ONE positive OLD word, including the index-two case. The represented terminal wrapper separately discharges the FULL cover/positivity prerequisites.

definitions.name: Full equivalence and nonempty diversity
definitions.statement: For nonzero original E>Id, E^circ=E minus Id is its occurring same-sort diversity palette. Id is never inserted as an edge; E may be Top.

definitions.name: Nonempty old profile menus
definitions.statement: P,Q,W are nonempty SAME-ENDPOINT-SORT invariant diversity menus. For the printed statements they are positive typed old word profiles; private word interiors can use other named original sorts, in their actual order.

definitions.name: J-saturation and quotient pullback
definitions.statement: For P define Phat=J^circ*P*J^circ=(J;P;J)^circ=Phi(Pbar). Quotient Delta lifts to J^circ, not real Id. RAW reflexivity gives P subset Phat even if P is not contained in J.

definitions.name: Same equivariant involution
definitions.statement: A symmetric serial quotient relation with one neighbour at each point is the graph of an equivariant involution. Under a transitive quotient action it is either identity everywhere or fixed-point-free everywhere.

definitions.name: Connectedness palette of W
definitions.statement: C_W is actual same-sort graph connectedness for the symmetric W relation, using zero/reverse/concatenated walks; F_W=C_W minus Id is a nonempty old diversity palette.

definitions.name: Complete J-semantic cylinder
definitions.statement: A cylinder is the FULL old diversity preimage of one quotient pair orbital. A nonempty arbitrary union of such cylinders is generally not complete and need not obey the exact return test.

definitions.name: Represented versus FULL cover
definitions.statement: J,K denote actual equivalences including equality. Represented exact MI/cover can be treated as FULL original MI/cover only after I05 under A04; positive J^circ words additionally use old SAP.

claims.name: Old invariant menus are symmetric serial actual relations
claims.statement: Every same-sort invariant relation is a union of symmetric old orbitals. A nonempty one has a neighbour at every point by transitivity. Products remain invariant; I02 gives RAW same-sort commutativity. This says nothing about reordering mixed original sorts.

claims.name: A nonzero old class has arbitrarily many distinct points
claims.statement: For E>Id choose a distinct E-pair and strongly amalgamate arbitrarily many copies over one anchor; old homogeneity identifies the anchor and transitivity handles every class. Thus each old E-class is infinite.

claims.name: Reproduction uses a genuine three-point old SAP fork
claims.statement: For nonempty C subset E^circ choose c in C and desired output atom s in E^circ. Align actual s-edge xz and c-edge xy over x; old SAP realizes y!=z. Their triangle has xy in C and yz in E^circ, so s in C*E^circ. Reverse endpoints/factors for E^circ*C. Reverse containments follow from actual E-transitivity.

claims.name: Equivalence reproduction and idempotence source export
claims.statement: C03 proves E^circ*C=E^circ=C*E^circ for every nonempty diversity C inside E. Put C=E^circ to obtain idempotence. No CCO, NR2, reachability or exactness is needed.

claims.name: Actual RAW walk products read out as positive STRONG words
claims.statement: For any finite word of old invariant diversity menus, align witnessed consecutive atom types in the old homogeneous source. I01 strict ancestor C01 injectivises the full finite path with distinct exterior endpoints pinned. Thus STRONG output equals the RAW endpoint relation restricted to distinct endpoints, including all expanded formal positions of each underlying old word. RAW associativity/I02 then yield SAME-SORT positive product associativity and commutation without CCO. Explicitly, align the two fine-endpoint witnesses for either grouping, then injectivise their concatenated path; its actual chord realizes the other grouping. Both parenthesizations therefore describe the SAME fully distinct concatenated old-word paths, not a mere formal off-diagonal truncation of RAW associativity.

claims.name: Saturation contains P by RAW reflexivity, not reproduction
claims.statement: I01 extended over atoms gives Phat=(J;P;J)^circ and Qhat analogously. Since full J contains Id, every diversity P-pair lies in that RAW saturation; hence P subset Phat, even when P exits J. I03 identifies each saturation with an invariant quotient relation, symmetric and serial by C01.

claims.name: A product inside J forces the quotient product inside Delta
claims.statement: If P*Q subset J^circ, C05 makes RAW P;Q subset full J, including any genuine diagonal outputs. RAW same-sort commutation and J-transitivity give (J;P;J);(J;Q;J) subset J. Equivalently by I03, Pbar;Qbar subset Delta_Q. Fresh representatives inside infinite J-classes justify the same implication even if intermediate quotient vertices repeat.

claims.name: Serial symmetric relations with product in Delta define one involution
claims.statement: For u Pbar v, every Qbar-neighbour of v must be u and seriality supplies one. By symmetry v Qbar u. Any Pbar-neighbour w of v then yields w (Pbar;Qbar) u, hence w=u. Thus both v-neighbour sets are the same singleton for EVERY v. Symmetry makes the resulting map iota self-inverse, and invariance makes it equivariant.

claims.name: A nonidentity quotient involution yields an original index-two interval
claims.statement: Transitivity and equivariance make a nonidentity iota fixed-point-free. Delta union Graph(iota) is then an invariant quotient equivalence with classes of size two. Pull it back to obtain an original invariant H>J with [H:J]=2. This uses no quotient homogeneity/SAP.

claims.name: Local index-two exclusion forces the identity quotient map
claims.statement: A03 rules out C09, so iota is literal identity. Both quotient relations lie in Delta, whence Phat,Qhat subset J^circ. By C06 RAW-reflexivity inclusions, P,Q themselves lie in J^circ. This implication needs old SAP and the local index-two exclusion only, not semantic CCO.

claims.name: Finite positive products inherit no-return without identity factors
claims.statement: A nonempty positive same-sort product can be grouped into its first factor and remaining positive product by C05. Old SAP realizes every compatible fork with distinct outer points, so the remaining product is nonempty. Apply C10, then induct on the remaining factors. No zero-length word or logical-Id menu is inserted.

claims.name: Typed no-return export retains the FULL/local terminal distinction
claims.statement: C10/C11 prove the printed terminal no-return assertion, and in fact the stronger local statement with A03 instead of global terminality. The source FULL original terminal NR2 implies A03. Private atomic-word interiors retain their typed order.

claims.name: An atom inside W forces every W-component to be nonbipartite
claims.statement: Choose an actual t subset W. I04 C19/C21 says t belongs to every sufficiently large positive t-power, including an EVEN one. A t-edge together with its witnessed even t-walk gives an odd closed t-walk, so each t-component is nonbipartite; original transitivity transports this to all vertices. Every W-component contains such a t-component and is therefore nonbipartite too.

claims.name: Every connected pair has all sufficiently long W-walks
claims.statement: In a connected nonbipartite W-graph, choose an endpoint path and an odd closed detour at its start. These provide both length parities; two-step backtracks increase either by every even amount. Thus any connected pair of distinct old endpoints has a W-walk of every length above a pair-dependent threshold.

claims.name: Finite original orbitals give ONE profile threshold
claims.statement: Connectedness is invariant, hence F_W is a union of finitely many occurring diversity atoms and contains t. Choose one actual pair from each such atom, apply C14 and take a common maximum N_W>=1. Old two-point homogeneity transports each witness walk to every other pair with that fine atom. This is uniformity in the ORIGINAL source, not arbitrary quotient cardinality.

claims.name: Expand W-steps before pinned injectivisation
claims.statement: Fix the one positive old atomic word defining W. For every step of a C15 W-walk, realize that old word and align its two endpoints by homogeneity to the step. Their concatenation is a homomorphism of the FULL expanded atomic word, allowing intermediate repetitions. Apply I01 C01 with the two distinct exterior endpoints pinned to split ALL atomic formal positions, not merely the coarse W-walk vertices. Thus every atom of F_W lies in W^n for every n>=N_W.

claims.name: Reverse containment and idempotence are actual connectivity
claims.statement: Every positive W-path stays inside one connectedness class, so every W^n lies in F_W. Together with C16 this gives equality eventually. C_W is a nonzero invariant equivalence, so C04 applied to it gives F_W*F_W=F_W. Alternatively compare sufficiently high n and2n via C05. Positive concatenations of the fixed word make F_W itself reachable.

claims.name: Profile pure-power source export is CCO-free
claims.statement: C13-C17 establish TWP under original full NR2, finite actual orbitals and visible SAP alone. Neither CCO nor MI, exactness, a typed hidden source or an arbitrary quotient graph theorem is imported. N_W is positive and depends on W and the fixed original source.

claims.name: A complete external cylinder is a whole quotient orbital pullback
claims.statement: A05 means T,S are individual disjoint-or-equal quotient orbital pullbacks, J-bisaturated and disjoint from J. Nonzero J supplies infinite original classes. An overlapping old fine atom therefore implies equal quotient orbitals; saturation alone would not suffice.

claims.name: A two-edge return inside J forces complete cylinders equal
claims.statement: For an actual distinct old triangle x T y S z with x J z, right-J saturation of S gives y S x. Symmetry gives x S y, while x T y already. The complete quotient orbitals overlap on this same old pair, so by C19 they are equal. This uses no CCO/NR2/exactness.

claims.name: Equal complete cylinders have a genuine diversity J-return
claims.statement: If T=S choose an actual old edge x T y. Pick z in infinite J[x] outside {x} by C02. Since T is external, y is outside J[x], so x,y,z are all distinct. J-saturation gives z T y and symmetry y T z. The actual triangle witnesses a member of (T*T) intersect J^circ.

claims.name: Exact complete-cylinder return export
claims.statement: C20/C21 prove JRT. Completeness and disjointness from J are essential stated premises, while original SAP only supplies the fresh third point. No MI, reset theorem, CCO, NR2 or positive cylinder word presentation is needed.

claims.name: Terminal RAW representation identifies FULL and exact lattice cuts
claims.statement: Under A04, I05 gives an original RAW atomic word for EVERY invariant equivalence. Thus represented exact MI J and its unique represented cover K in A06 are the actual FULL invariant MI/cover, without using distributivity or hidden SAP.

claims.name: Nonzero J has a positive STRONG word before layer selection
claims.statement: Its I05 RAW word cannot consist entirely of logical equality letters because J>Id. Delete literal Id steps, leaving a positive old diversity word. Its distinct-endpoint part is exactly J^circ by old pinned word injection C05/I01. All private intermediate original sorts are retained.

claims.name: The earlier FULL-cover provider yields the represented layer
claims.statement: C23/C24 discharge the local FULL-cover and positive-J premises of I06. Therefore K minus J is nonempty and the STRONG endpoint profile of ONE positive old atomic word. This proves the remaining represented cover-layer theorem with no extra mixed-sort theta construction or hidden SAP.

claims.name: No-return fails at an index-two quotient even with original SAP
claims.statement: In an infinite clone cover of the regular V4 difference structure, let J be clone equality and P=Q the full preimage of one nonzero difference. Their STRONG product is J^circ but P exits J. The original source is homogeneous and SAP; the original invariant interval generated by that involution has relative index two, violating A03. The example makes no terminal claim.

claims.name: Incomplete saturated unions invalidate the exact return equivalence
claims.statement: In the same clone V4 model take complete external Ri for the three nonzero differences, T=R1 union R2 and S=R2 union R3. They are J-saturated, external, distinct and share R2. The product has a J^circ return through R2 twice, yet T!=S. Hence completeness in A05 cannot be weakened to arbitrary saturated unions.

claims.name: A zero cut cannot supply a diversity quotient diagonal
claims.statement: If J=Id, Phi(Delta)=empty. The fresh third point of C21 and the faithful nonempty diversity pullback used by no-return no longer follow. Proper nonzero cuts remain explicit. No artificial identity atom repairs the missing premise.

claims.name: Finite windows do not prove unbounded strong powers
claims.statement: Finite diagnostic windows have only finitely many distinct real vertices, so cannot realize arbitrarily long injective paths. They test actual bounded paths, quotient returns, reproduction and layer witnesses only; the unbounded theorem is C13-C18 with infinite source SAP and finite orbital uniformity.

claims.name: Three different terminal strengths remain separated
claims.statement: Reproduction/complete return need only old SAP. No-return needs A03 at its cut. Profile powers need FULL original NR2 A04 but no CCO. The represented positive layer uses A06 semantic CCO via I06 and separate I05 representation. None of these is inferred from hidden or quotient SAP.

claims.name: Original typed word interiors never license mixed commutation
claims.statement: Every menu in the same-sort product has both endpoints on the one chosen original sort. Its private atomic word may visit other named sorts, but C05 concatenates those literal words without reordering their interior factors. Only the resulting same-sort invariant endpoint relations commute.

claims.name: Finite diagnostics and existing source gates remain
claims.statement: The controls check bounded actual clone/quotient models and distinguish complete cylinders, index-two failure and old versus quotient diagonal. They prove no general NR2, original CCO, source09 layer provider, hidden SAP or compiled Lean. Existing B047 actual/FULL-sector scope and the five HN/HKN receiving bindings remain unchanged.
